Question: Which non-values in the client_secret slot of an Instagram token exchange can be asserted without taking a position on the Instagram App ID? Options: Assert placeholders, references, masks and empty values; or also assert a literal App ID as public; or assert none. Decision: Assert placeholders, references, masks, empty values and a prose mention; no literal App ID. Reason: The contract records that no page calls the Instagram App ID non-secret.
